title.narrative: In 2024, the Dominican Republic reached a historic milestone, with the approval of Ordinance 05-2024 by the National Education Council. This ordinance establishes the Inclusive Education Guidelines for the national educational system and approves a Progressive Scale Plan for the implementation of the Inclusive Education Model, all supported by UNICEF.
